title: World map and sentence frame sheet
subject: Arabic
unit: Spring 1: My new home; my room and furniture; describing my appearance and clothes
source: Written for arabic/y5 lesson 2 (World map and sentence frame sheet (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 2: Bridge: back to school; where are you from?. Read the Arabic aloud, then do the tasks. Write in Arabic with all the harakat.

panels.title: Where are you from?
points: مِنْ أَيْنَ أَنْتَ؟ (min ayna anta?) to a boy
مِنْ أَيْنَ أَنْتِ؟ (min ayna anti?) to a girl

panels.title: He is from, she is from
points: No word for 'is' in Arabic here

parts.text: Start with أَنَا (I). Add مِنْ (from). Add the country: بِرِيطَانِيَا.

blocks.text: Colour the three countries. Under the map, write a sentence for each: أَنَا مِنْ ... / هُوَ مِنْ ... / هِيَ مِنْ ...

keywords.def: where are you from? (to a boy)

questions.q: Answer: مِنْ أَيْنَ أَنْتَ؟ (say you are from Britain)
Core: Write a short introduction: greeting, name, where you are from.
questions.a: For example: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ. اِسْمِي مَرْيَمُ. أَنَا مِنْ بِرِيطَانِيَا.

questions.q: Extend: Write two lines about a classmate with هُوَ or هِيَ, e.g. اِسْمُهُ آدَمُ. هُوَ مِنْ ...
questions.a: For example: اِسْمُهَا سَارَةُ. هِيَ مِنْ تُرْكِيَا.

questions.q: Stretch: Write a short dialogue of four lines between two pupils meeting for the first time.
questions.a: For example: صَبَاحُ الخَيْرِ. صَبَاحُ النُّورِ. مِنْ أَيْنَ أَنْتَ؟ أَنَا مِنْ مِصْرَ.

questions.q: How do you ask a girl where she is from?
questions.a: B) مِنْ أَيْنَ أَنْتِ؟. أَنْتِ (anti) with a kasrah is 'you' to a girl.

questions.q: What does مِنْ أَيْنَ mean? A) where from? B) how are you? C) what is your name?
Big question: greet me and tell me where you are from.
questions.a: For example: صَبَاحُ الخَيْرِ. أَنَا مِنْ بِرِيطَانِيَا.
